# lsb-pr-review

Review LandSandBoat changes the way the upstream maintainers actually review them. Use before opening a PR against LandSandBoat/server, when reviewing an LSB diff/branch/PR, or when writing Lua/SQL/C++ for LSB and you want it to pass review first time. Rules derived from ~2900 maintainer review comments on LandSandBoat/server (Aug 2024 - Aug 2026).

See [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) for the full instructions, and the [repo README](../../README.md) for how skills are installed.
